entry.title: New: InfiniteDSH
entry.summary: Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel. Exact install spec: github:vdnight89/infinitedsh. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
